claims.statement: The prohibition no-active-content follows from the constraints it names.

basis.derivation: The prohibition states the negation of what a named constraint permits.

requirements.statement: Deliver the chart as an SVG rendered from the delivered Vega-Lite specification.

prohibitions.statement: The SVG may not carry script, event handlers or external references.

constraints.statement: A delivered artifact is named by the sha-256 ni name of its bytes; equal bytes have equal names, so acceptance is evidence about those bytes alone.
The deliverable is a well-formed SVG document.
A chart is the deterministic rendering of a valid Vega-Lite specification.
Acceptance is a SignCell cell per assay: subject the artifact ni, predicate the assay id, witnesses the assay evidence.

acceptanceObligations.statement: The delivered specification validates as Vega-Lite.
Rendering the delivered specification again yields exactly the delivered SVG bytes.
The SVG has an svg root and carries no script, event handler, foreignObject or external reference.
